page.overview:
What is Arges?

Arges was a planet that was believed to be the homeworld of the arges frog, a type of frog that had come to inhabit the forests and deserts of several other worlds, including Nevarro, Ossus, and Arvala-7, by the New Republic Era. Galactic Society of Creature Enthusiasts Director of Creature Cartography Ardis San Tekka mentioned Arges when writing about arges frogs in her journal

The planet Arges was mentioned in the reference book Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy, which was written by S.T. Bende Prior to the book's release, the page mentioning Arges was first revealed in a StarWars.com article published on October 22, 2024.

Star Wars Bestiary, Vol. 1: Creatures of the Galaxy
